outcome.name: resolved_without_reopen_14d
outcome.acceptable_when: case is resolved and is not reopened within 14 days
outcome.available_after: 14 days after the terminal case event

proxies.name: same_session_acceptance
proxies.agreement_measure: fixture-only confusion matrix; no production estimate
failure_modes: acceptance can precede a later reopen
silent abandonment can look like acceptance

joins.deduplication: retain the first decision and latest terminal outcome per case
joins.late_data: recompute the cohort after the 14-day outcome window closes

predictive.calibration: synthetic calibration table by support queue
predictive.threshold_policy: route only at the pre-committed threshold

agent.human_handoff: handoff when authorization, evidence, or tool execution is incomplete

interventions.test: paired replay with the same case manifest
interventions.rollback_trigger: calibration error worsens on any pre-committed queue

interventions.hypothesis: a frozen curated index improves delayed task outcomes
interventions.test: paired case assignment against the current index
interventions.rollback_trigger: outcome lift is absent or unsupported-citation rate increases

interventions.hypothesis: a deterministic pre-check reduces failed writes
interventions.test: canary with a complete side-effect ledger
interventions.rollback_trigger: failed-write rate or human remediation increases

rollout.canary: pre-committed hash-ranked 10 percent of eligible synthetic cases
rollout.advance_when: the delayed outcome improves without a pre-committed slice regression
rollout.rollback_when: any safety gate fails or joined outcome coverage is incomplete

non_claims: This is a synthetic contract fixture, not a measured production result.
The proxy is not validated as a substitute for the delayed outcome.
The contract validates completeness, not the truth of issuer assertions.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.10+ with no third-party runtime dependencies
